description: This file defines an interface 'IStreamQueueMapper' for mapping stream identifiers to queue identifiers in Orleans streaming infrastructure. It declares methods to retrieve all queues and to get the specific queue for a given stream, emphasizing thread safety.

classes.name: IStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping streams to queues in Orleans streaming system, responsible for retrieving all queues and mapping a stream to its queue, requiring thread safety.

methods.name: GetAllQueues
methods.description: Returns an enumerable collection of all queue identifiers managed by the mapper.

methods.name: GetQueueForStream
methods.description: Returns the queue identifier responsible for the given stream identifier.
